flags.message: The provisioned snapshot and document manifest assign April 1, 2026 to the petition filing, but the petition is signed May 22, its document URL is May-dated, and the docketing date is May 28. I did not use the apparent April filing interval as a signal. No BIO is provisioned and no response or waiver appears in the snapshot, so the respondent's cert-stage position is unknown, not assumed waived. Forecast completed without retrieving this petition's live state or outcome.
